heroes-jobs-inc.notes: Still unnamed. TechCrunch (2023-05-27): 'The startup raised $9 million in prior venture funding across two rounds' and chose a sale over 'a signed term sheet for a Series A', so both rounds are pre-Series A, but neither is named and Speedinvest is not named in any press. The first Form D (first sale 2019-03-05, USD 1,399,999, director Mathias Ockenfels of Speedinvest x) is the earlier of the two, seed-stage by position, with no Series A ever raised. Form D: year of incorporation 2018 (Delaware). Searched: TechCrunch, Maddyness and FrenchWeb site search (only 'Heroes Job' app mentions, 2018).

five-lives.notes: Still unnamed. Sifted (2022-11-15): 'has raised €3.7m ... in a round led by US VC Headline and Austria’s Speedinvest'; Femtech Insider: 'has now raised €3.7M in funding led by Headline and Speedinvest'; neither names the round, and only a vendor profile (Crunchbase) labels it seed. Maddyness (2026-04-03) counts it among the earlier tours: 'les précédents, conduits en 2021 et 2023 auprès de fonds européens dont Headline, Speed Invest et Boost Capital, avaient représenté plus de trois millions d'euros au total', and says 'La structure est créée en France en 2021'; Femtech Insider says 'Founded in 2019'. By position this is the company's first institutional round (seed-stage) with no Series A since (the 2026 raise is a EUR 2M round plus crowdfunding). Used 1 WebSearch.
